en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a wooden railway station building taken from the track side. The long, two‑storey structure has steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, and small entrance porches. Railway tracks and the platform occupy the foreground, with trees and a few bicycles visible around the station. Printed captions in Swedish appear in the lower corners of the image.
